posts.name: arenson9
posts.cooked:
Something we noticed tonight -- different versions of the app can't find each other for multiplayer games. We had a couple people on private beta, and three people on public beta. None of the private beta people could find games made by the public beta people or vice versa. Also, one of the people on private beta was on Android and a version ahead of the other two private beta people, so couldn't see them either. All five people had all DLC and all variants unlocked.

 

One of the people also noticed that even though they were on the private beta in Steam, when they tried to switch over to a laptop and get the private beta working there, despite the fact that they used to be able to use the private beta from either their laptop or desktop, every attempt to get the latest version just got them the public beta.

arenson9:

Something we noticed tonight – different versions of the app can't find each other for multiplayer games.
